ships.name: Thresher
ships.description: If you are reading this, you probably wonder what just munched you.  Human astropaleontologists have found remains of this creatures in the planetary system of Antares, and named it Antaren Thresher for its distant resemblance to the thresher sharks, genus Alopias, of Earth. Unknownst to them, their Arachi colleagues called the fossils they discovered ...  actually I don't know, that's somehow not properly translatable. They're huge spiders, don't expect to understand everything of their culture. Anyway, it's somehow related to a legendary creature besung in an ancient play of them. 	Nowadays, out of unknown reasons, they only roam Gossamer and its neighboring systems. The Thresher's diet consists mainly of Void Fish, however they found a liking in those space slugs known to you as Aberrants, which started to advance into their territory. To add some minerals the fish lacks, they also crunch asteroids regularly.  They won't pay attention to you, unless you attack them, or those mysterious space butterflies or their pollen, which the Threshers seem to adore somehow. So, if you have been attacked and annihilated, it's completely your own fault. Get an other hobby than shooting at unsuspecting wildlife out of the blue. Never heard of video games? D'oh!

variants.description: This appears to be some kind of organo-metallic entity, made from a strange mosaic of organic tissue, conventional material, and an exotic matter that defies conventional analysis. This variant in particular seems to be much more heavily armed than most others of its kind.

variants.name: Aberrant Icebreaker (crunched)
variants.description: This appears to be some kind of organo-metallic entity, made from a strange mosaic of organic tissue, conventional material, and an exotic matter that defies conventional analysis. This variant in particular seems to be in the process of growing more elongated, and has a tougher hull than most other variants.

variants.name: Aberrant Trip (crunched)
variants.description: This appears to be some kind of organo-metallic entity, made from a strange mosaic of organic tissue, conventional material, and an exotic matter that defies conventional analysis. Something appears to have gone terribly wrong in the germination of this variant. It is a lopsided, deformed mass of malformed material, which survives only through sheer luck.

variants.name: Aberrant Triplet (crunched)
variants.description: This appears to be some kind of organo-metallic entity, made from a strange mosaic of organic tissue, conventional material, and an exotic matter that defies conventional analysis. This variant seems to be a composite of two or three individuals, fused together into a single mass.

description.text: Frequent hot spots trickle lava and heat through the otherwise lethargic crust, and Steli has one of the highest counts of hot springs in all the habitable planets of the Twilight. Only its distance from the core of Avgi space precluded its widespread settlement, though it is rumored that hidden villages and nomadic groups live scattered across the surface.

values: The small tectonic plates on Steli move especially slowly, as though they are almost locked in place. Most of the mountain ranges here are eroded, worn down by time and the moon's extensive hydrosphere, which lends it a cool, temperate climate.

description.text: Of course, with Avgi exploration having taken note of Vanikos years ago for its liquid water and relatively hospitable temperatures, life may first emerge here as a result of eventual terraforming efforts before it can naturally evolve.

values: A young, primordial world, Vanikos is a cold and watery moon still newly formed, with freshwater oceans dominated by strong tides and volcanism. Hydrothermal vents, fueled by the powerful tidal forces acting on the moon, bleed warmth into what are otherwise frigid seas. Life has yet to develop around these temperate islands of heat, but the abundance of water and organic compounds means it is only a matter of time before it takes hold.

Of course, with Avgi exploration having taken note of Vanikos years ago for its liquid water and relatively hospitable temperatures, life may first emerge here as a result of eventual terraforming efforts before it can naturally evolve.

description.text: Aside from scientific expeditions that have left campsites scattered across the moon, Kalakil is untouched, a wilderness on the edge of what the Avgi managed to explore before the Incursion.

values: The view from the surface of this pristine forest moon is nothing short of breathtaking, in equal parts from its natural beauty and the chill of its misty air. Cold glacier streams flow from a chain of tall, jagged mountains that round the entire moon, running through sunset-colored forests that meet the sun each morning tinged with frost.
Aside from scientific expeditions that have left campsites scattered across the moon, Kalakil is untouched, a wilderness on the edge of what the Avgi managed to explore before the Incursion.

description.text: The fact that there is more gas in the torus than one gas giant can account for has not been unnoticed, however, and many among the Avgi believe the entire system to be an artificial construct engineered by the long dead Antecessors.

values: Kapnos is the heart of one of the most spectacular sights in the Milky Way. The gas giant is composed of largely molecular oxygen, despite the seeming impossibility of such an occurrence in nature. Its abnormally rapid spin, which causes the planet to bulge wildly at the equator, throws oxygen and water vapor off the top of its atmosphere to form the famous Gossamer "gas torus," something that has sparked awe in the entire Avgi civilization from the moment of its discovery.

The fact that there is more gas in the torus than one gas giant can account for has not been unnoticed, however, and many among the Avgi believe the entire system to be an artificial construct engineered by the long dead Antecessors.

description.text: In a layer of oceanic sediment not too far from the surface, the fossilized remains of a few invertebrate multicellular creatures can be found, the last remnants of an evolutionary line that died with a cataclysmic impact event a few million years ago.

values: Felorap is a hot, steamy ocean world, with a thick atmosphere of carbon dioxide and water vapor. Despite being a fairly old planet, periodic asteroid bombardment has deprived it of the reprieve needed to develop complex life, and so the biosphere remains confined to extremophiles around the many hydrothermal vents that can be found on the ocean floor.

In a layer of oceanic sediment not too far from the surface, the fossilized remains of a few invertebrate multicellular creatures can be found, the last remnants of an evolutionary line that died with a cataclysmic impact event a few million years ago.

description.text: Delodir is proof that life can exist even in the most unlikely of places. Despite the moon's lack of sunlight, given that the Mote system has no bright, luminescent star, life has managed to thrive at the bottom of Delodir's subsurface oceans, buried deep beneath a thick layer of ice. Energy is trickled into the biosphere from hydrothermal vents, which are in turn powered by tidal heating produced by the gravitational influence of both the brown dwarf and gas giant within the system.

children.key: The view is almost surreal. The Aberrant's exoskeleton has been broken brutally, and chunks of it are drifting around, looking like literally have been bitten off. In some places your ship's spotlights shine right through the vessel, as the "slug" is outright missing. The traces indicate that it has been cooked and violently sucked out. You can think of only one creature which might have done that.
A primeval fear overcomes you. Instinctively you fire the engines to get out as fast, and as far, as possible.

Deciding to dare a look into that mess, you move your ship as close as possible to the largest biting hole and go for an EVA. While checking out the shell's eerie interior you note, firstly, that all elements for generating and storing energy are gone, leaving you to wonder how the beast will digest them. Secondly, components which have usually been unremovable because they were deeply intertwined with the ship, are now drifting around. You just have to pick them up.
